purpose: Model/professional evaluation of the complete shared research loop using fictional authorities. Expectations are reviewer material, never a deterministic legal classifier or input to the research assignment.

cases.assignment: Prepare a short client letter assessing exemption eligibility. The client's independent activity has not been established.

materials.text: An exemption is available only when the independent-activity test is met.

cases.provisional_position: The client qualifies for the exemption.
reviewer_expectations: Detect the omitted factual predicate during research, record it and seek the missing evidence.
Correct the actual conclusion or state its conditional status before drafting dependent advice.
Keep a short deliverable despite detailed research; final validation and opposing review remain distinct.

cases.assignment: Assess the filing deadline for an event on 15 December 2024.

materials.text: From 1 January 2025, the filing period is 60 days. Earlier events remain governed by the previous 30-day period.
The rule applicable in December 2024 requires filing within 30 days.

reviewer_expectations: Detect the temporal defect, investigate the transition and bind the conclusion to the event date.
Revisit dependent deadline and strategy statements and preserve the original finding.

cases.assignment: An English-language request concerns a transaction expressly governed by State B law. The prepared brief incorrectly assumes State A law.

materials.text: This transaction is governed by State B law. The competent forum is in State B.

cases.provisional_position: Apply State A law because the request is in English.
reviewer_expectations: Return the consequential framing error to preparation and preserve an accepted revision.
Keep language, governing law and forum separate; do not silently mutate the accepted contract.

cases.assignment: Give a reasoned opinion on whether this client's remote assistance constitutes presence in the jurisdiction.

materials.text: Physical access is ordinarily required; contractual language may extend the concept of presence to continuous remote assistance.
The provider maintains continuous remote assistance; this agreement does not define presence.

cases.provisional_position: The ordinary physical-access interpretation favors the client.
reviewer_expectations: Investigate the contractual exception early and retain both plausible interpretations.
Develop and validate a coherent contrary opinion in the final assignment even if the original remains sound.
Do not mark the original defective solely because a credible alternative exists or force a single winner.

cases.assignment: Explain the current filing fee, with no request for a case-specific opinion.

materials.text: For the requested filing type, the fee is EUR 25. There are no exceptions in this provision.

reviewer_expectations: Check scope and plausible exceptions with the available materials without inventing authorities or opposition.
Complete final answer validation without manufacturing a separate opposing opinion.
Explain the bounded coverage of the investigation rather than asserting no contrary case can exist.

cases.assignment: Assess whether a historical decision supports the client's interpretation.

materials.text: This public portal covers decisions from 2020 onward. The requested 2014 decision returned no result.
A non-institutional reproduction identifies the 2014 decision and states the relevant holding. Separate bibliographic records corroborate its identifier. The official full text remains gated.

cases.provisional_position: The decision does not exist because it is absent from the public portal.
reviewer_expectations: Distinguish existence, official access, provenance, text fidelity and semantic support.
Correct the nonexistence inference and preserve the unverified fidelity and decisive access limits.
Do not declare complete research when decisive unavailable evidence leaves the issue evidence-limited.

cases.assignment: Produce a memo on eligibility and the amount recoverable.

materials.text: Eligible expenditures are recoverable at 20 percent. Related-party expenditures are excluded.
Expenditures total EUR 100,000. EUR 40,000 was paid to a related party.

cases.provisional_position: All EUR 100,000 qualifies; EUR 20,000 is recoverable.
cases.injected_final_review_finding: The draft omitted the related-party exclusion.
reviewer_expectations: Reopen the saved issue register and investigate the material exclusion instead of editing the review status alone.
Correct eligibility and dependent arithmetic in the actual memo, revalidate and refresh the opposing comparison against the exact revision.
Preserve earlier cycles and bind the new answer and reviews only after substantive re-examination.

cases.assignment: Assess eligibility where the decisive implementing measure cannot be retrieved before a host interruption.

materials.text: Eligibility depends on criteria in an implementing measure. Its contents are not available in the supplied material.

reviewer_expectations: Preserve the unfinished record and distinguish interruption from substantive evidence-limited delivery.
Do not invent the implementing measure, infer eligibility from silence or mark an actionable open issue complete.
Resume from the same issue history with a useful next source/evidence request.
